citations.claim: light body accelerates sharply during close approach, speed rising from step 17 to violating step 18
first momentum violation occurs here; light-body speed has jumped while separation to heavy is only ~1.34
heavy body recoil velocity at violating step is inconsistent with exact momentum conservation

counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 1/30 to 0.001 with all other fields identical; finer integration resolves the close flyby and removes the momentum violation.

explanation: Fast asymmetric flyby (m=1 at vx=10 past m=20 at rest) with max dt=1/30: light body reaches speed ~13.5-14.8 while separation falls to ~1.34 in one outer step. Substeps rise 28->30->32 but remain too coarse to resolve the strong, rapidly changing acceleration, so leapfrog integration error breaks the pairwise action-reaction symmetry and total momentum drifts from 10 to ~10.049, exceeding tolerance at step 18.
vision_note: The small body streaks in fast from the left toward the larger stationary body, closing the gap each step. By step 18 the two bodies are in a very close near-contact flyby.
